title: Kona Blue materials were Kingman 1953 wreckage

tellings.quote: I I myself have heard this involved the Kingman wreckage from the 1953 Kingman Arizona crash

plain: Kona Blue was a proposed secret government programme to hold and study recovered UFO material, and the claim is that the material it was meant to cover was wreckage from a craft said to have crashed near Kingman, Arizona, in 1953. An anonymous online researcher who posts as UAPGerb tells Michels "I myself have heard this", relaying what he says he was told by a man named Jim Ryder. If true, it would tie a modern programme to a crash from the early 1950s.
